request.prompt: Instrumental gentle but purposeful anime naval escort battle theme, protecting companions while calmly learning command. Mellow middle-register clarinet plays a simple tuneful eight-bar melody with a graceful rising question and a reassuring answer. Soft piano chords and light viola motion accompany it; a warm horn answers only at phrase endings. A short opening leads into the clear main theme, a compact closely related contrasting melody, and an easily recognized varied return. Keep the second half melodically coherent and singable, with stable tonal harmony, natural cadences and gradual transitions. Maintain quiet forward motion for the complete two minutes, without drifting into abstract improvisation. Finish with the same gentle moving accompaniment to offer a possible body loop. Small transparent ensemble. No sudden key changes, jagged chromatic runs, dense high strings or heavy percussion. Entirely instrumental, music only: no singing, choir, speech, environmental sounds or combat effects. Clear acoustic instrument separation, comfortable middle registers, natural connected phrases and restrained dynamics.
